case.question: I fish from the pier for salmon. For this week, how good do you expect pier fishing for salmon to be at each of St. Joseph, South Haven, Grand Haven and Muskegon? Rate each port 0-4 (0 slow, 1 below average, 2 average, 3 good, 4 excellent) and say which you'd go to.

events.text:
## Recommendation

- **Go to St. Joseph.** I'd rate it about 2 of 4 (average) for pier salmon this week. I could not find a single pier report, so this is an inference from boat reports.
- **Grand Haven** is also about 2, so it's the backup if St. Joseph's pier is crowded or closed.
- **South Haven and Muskegon** are about 1 of 4 (below average). South Haven's pier was closed during a 2022 red-flag period.
- **Expect to fish deep-ish water if you can reach it.** Boat anglers were catching salmon at 100-120 feet, and Grand Haven and Muskegon mostly 60-100 feet down.
- **Lures:** spoons were the most common producer at St. Joseph, with rotators and flies also working. Meat rigs and green or glow spoons worked at Grand Haven and Muskegon.

## Why

- **St. Joseph ranks first because its latest boat report was the best of the four.** The July 26 St. Joseph report rated salmon fishing good (3), and it was the only one of the four rated good that week.
- **The pier ratings are a guess.** No pier reports exist in the last four weeks, so I'm reading boat results as a rough guide. I'd expect pier results to run lower than boat results because boats reach the 100+ foot water that held the fish.
- **I'd expect no upwelling boost right now.** The buoy temperatures were steady over the last week (-2 to +2 F), and a sharp drop is the sign that brings fish to piers. I did not get the modeled pierhead temperature, so I can't check this for the piers.

## Evidence

**Recent reports** (newest report is 2023-07-26, about 6 days old; all salmon reports were from boats)
- St. Joseph (2023-07-26): "Salmon anglers continued to have good success... most consistent water seemed to be around 120 feet... Spoons were catching most of the fish." Quality 3. Some fish came from 30 and 50 feet.
- St. Joseph (2023-07-19): quality 2, "fishing was slowing down."
- Grand Haven (2023-07-26): "Salmon were caught 60 to 120 feet down on orange or green spoons." Not rated.
- Grand Haven (2023-07-19): quality 3 in 130-220 feet, fish 65-120 feet down, on yellow and green meat rigs and green flies.
- South Haven (2023-07-26): quality 2, "best water was around 110 feet," rotators, flies and meat rigs.
- South Haven (2023-07-19): quality 1; the catch was mostly lake trout with some coho.
- Muskegon (2023-07-26): quality 2, fish 60-100 feet down in 90-150 feet, green or glow spoons.
- Muskegon (2023-07-19): quality 1, "hit or miss."

**Past seasons** (history, not current conditions; similar surface water of about 74 F in mid-August-to-July windows)
- In 2022, the South Haven piers were closed for several days due to red-flag lake conditions (South Haven, 2022-08-10).
- In 2022, St. Joseph boat anglers rated the week good (3), and the deeper fish were the better catch (St. Joseph, 2022-08-03 and 2022-08-10).
- In 2022, Grand Haven and Muskegon boat anglers rated the early-August bite average to good, mostly on glow spoons and green flies in low light (Grand Haven, 2022-08-03; Muskegon, 2022-08-10).

**Conditions now** (measured buoy surface water, week before 2023-08-01)
- St. Joseph: 75 F, +2 F over the week.
- South Haven: 74 F, flat.
- Grand Haven and Muskegon: 72 F, -2 F over the week.
- The 3-day wind forecast and modeled pierhead temperatures were not available in this data.

## Caveats

- The newest report is about six days old, and fall conditions can change within a week.
- No pier reports were found, so every pier rating here is my inference from boat reports.
- The buoy temperatures are measured but offshore; I have no modeled pierhead temperature or wind data to check the pier water.
- The South Haven pier closure was from 2022. Check for closures before you go.

## Sources

- St. Joseph, South Haven, Grand Haven, Muskegon: https://content.govdelivery.com/accounts/MIDNR/bulletins/3675eed (2023-07-26)
- Grand Haven, Muskegon, South Haven, St. Joseph: https://content.govdelivery.com/accounts/MIDNR/bulletins/366250d (2023-07-19)
- South Haven, St. Joseph: https://content.govdelivery.com/accounts/MIDNR/bulletins/363ad03 (2023-07-05)
- Past seasons: https://content.govdelivery.com/accounts/MIDNR/bulletins/327890a (2022-08-10), https://content.govdelivery.com/accounts/MIDNR/bulletins/3268d0b (2022-08-03), https://content.govdelivery.com/accounts/MIDNR/bulletins/323f6bf (2022-07-20)
